meta.label: Phase 1.5 Baseline Targets
meta.description: Reference targets for the 8-ball pool physics engine calibration. Measured from 20-iteration runs after Phase 1.4 stabilization.

spread.label: Max object ball spread from table center

pockets.label: Number of pocketed balls on break

drawBack.label: Cue ball position change on draw (noSpinX - drawX). Negative = inverted, will be addressed when fixing spin normalization
drawBack.note: Deterministic in 2-ball setup. Sign inverted due to normalization bug in applyFrictionAndSpin

followThrough.label: Cue ball position change on follow (followX - noSpinX). Negative = inverted, same normalization bug
followThrough.note: Deterministic in 2-ball setup. Sign inverted due to normalization bug

passRate.label: Fraction of shots that bounce off right rail at 85% power

finalX.label: Final x position of cue ball after 45-degree bank shot

knownIssues.description: applyFrictionAndSpin uses (nvx / nspd) instead of nvx for direction, doubling the normalization divisor. This makes spin effect velocity-dependent in a quadratic way and inverts direction in certain speed regimes.
knownIssues.impact: Draw and follow tests show inverted sign. Spin transfer at high speeds is weaker than intended.
